title: Standardize Codex skill workflow and config
description:
Why this issue exists and what needs to be done

The repo has an in-progress migration from older Khuym/Claude-oriented workflow files to the current Codex + mnhat + bd setup. The remaining work is to finalize the skill set, simplify using-mnhat, align project config, and publish the changes as a clean set of focused commits.

Done when:
- workflow skill docs align with AGENTS.md
- legacy local config references are removed from live repo paths
- project .codex/config.toml matches the current repo workflow
- changes are committed and pushed in small logical commits
